main.description: Get a specific item received by the authenticated user (as the recipient/subject). Looks up by item record uri, sender DID, or record uri. These are mutually exclusive and resolved in that order.

uri.description: AT-URI of the item record. Takes precedence over sender and recordUri.

sender.description: DID of the item sender. Takes precedence over recordUri.

recordUri.description: AT-URI of the record being tipped. Ignored if uri or sender is provided.
